title: Low-Degree Fourier Weight Bound
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\alpha\in\bbr$. Suppose $f$ takes only the values $0$ and $1$ and its mean is $\alpha$. Then the sum of its squared Fourier coefficients over subsets of size at most $k$ is at most $3^k\alpha^{3/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
